# ledger account currency

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ledgerAccountCurrency`](gmeow-ledgerAccountCurrency.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ledgerAccountCurrency>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

The currency(ies) in which the ledger account tracks balances. Non-functional: a single logical ledger account may track several currency buckets (multi-currency bookkeeping). The functional constraint moves to individual [`Posting`](../classes/gmeow-Posting.md) relators.
